title: Stop tracking .docker/prod/env/.env in Git
description: Remove the environment file from the Git index, keep it locally, ignore it in .gitignore, and update docs that say it is tracked.

title: Create mandatory project documentation
description: Create the mandatory documentation set required by AGENTS.md section 8 under docs/: index, setup, RULES, DESCRIPTION, ARCHITECTURE, DOCUMENTS, configuration, deployment, testing, ADR index plus initial ADR. API/OpenAPI/modules/libraries/database are not applicable (no HTTP API, no DB).
acceptance_criteria: All applicable documents from the AGENTS.md document map exist in English, match current source (.docker/prod, Makefile), and README links to docs/.
